st: In season 1, Dr. Bromwell keeps Max Dillon alive after his accident, then sends May home from the hospital and drives her there.
In season 2, he makes a house call on Valentine's Day and tells May she is fit as a fiddle.

add.k: A Midtown High football player, Robbie Robertson's son
st: In season 1, Rand plays football for Midtown, dates Sally and helps catch Gwen when Venom hurls her toward the street.
In season 2, he catches a key pass as the Mustangs win State, and teases Flash when Sha Shan skips his party.

add.k: A Midtown High sophomore Flash keeps asking out
st: In season 2, Sha Shan Nguyen keeps turning Flash down, then dances with him on Valentine's Day once he proves he is honest.

add.k: A Broadway star directing Midtown High's school play
st: In season 2, Broadway star St. John Devereaux directs Midtown's A Midsummer Night's Dream and sends Hobie on as Puck when Harry is missing.

add.k: An NYPD sergeant, Officer DeWolff's partner
st: In season 1, Stan Carter hears his partner say Spider-Man's arrests never stick, and answers the call when the Sinister Six attack.
In season 2, Sergeant Carter backs Spider-Man and tells students on a ride-along that Spider-Man hasn't gone far enough.

add.k: A wrestling promoter who hires Spider-Man
st: In season 1, wrestling promoter Sullivan Edwards won't pay Spider-Man without a contract, and Spider-Man lets the thief who robs him escape.

add.k: A Tri-Corp scientist holding Otto's power source
st: In season 1, Dr. Twaki tells Doctor Octopus where the Megalo-pack is, explains it to Spider-Man and goes into hiding.

add.k: Curt and Martha Connors's young son
st: In season 1, Billy sees his father become the Lizard and follows him to the zoo, giving Spider-Man the opening to cure him.
In season 2, Billy leaves New York with his parents when they move to Florida.

k: Head of the network that airs Eddie's show
st: Jack warns Eddie to go easy on Carlton Drake, then fires him for accusing Drake on camera without a source.
Richard, a guard at Eddie's building, celebrates his daughter's scholarship to MIT with Eddie.
He bars a fired Eddie from going upstairs, and Eddie stops Venom from eating him.

k: A detective believed dead, now a symbiote host
st: As a young officer, Mulligan shoots Frances in the eye and believes he has killed her.
Now a detective, he brings Eddie to Kasady, then arrests and grills Eddie after Kasady escapes as Carnage.
Taken hostage to Kasady's cathedral wedding, he survives Frances's scream, and his eyes flash with a piece of Carnage.
Believed dead, he is held at Area 51, where his new symbiote tells Strickland the Codex dies only if Eddie or Venom does.
He urges a captured Eddie to free the symbiote army, then is devoured when a Xenophage attacks the base.
Nova and her husband Martin take in hitchhiker Eddie and drive him to Las Vegas, then go on to Area 51 with their kids.
At Area 51 the family is caught in the battle with the Xenophages and gets out alive.
Echo jokes that hitchhiker Eddie is a serial killer as her family drives him to Las Vegas, then on to Area 51.
Leaf sneaks Eddie chocolate and admits he fears aliens, and at Area 51 Eddie reveals his best friend is one.
Andre runs with the 110th Street Gang until Lonnie joins the gang in his place to free him.
Andre tells Lonnie that joining the gang to save him was the wrong call and that he can't hide it forever.

k: The strict Oscorp scientist over the interns
st: Dr. Wittman takes charge of Oscorp's four new interns and berates Peter for wandering the secure building.
He tears apart Peter's battery pitch in front of the other interns.
He joins the Oscorp scientists briefing Norman on secret projects, among them a spider injected with Peter's blood.

k: Peter's science teacher at Bales High
st: Mr. Taylor lets his class choose lab partners, and Lonnie asks to work with Peter.
With Lonnie missing class again, he pairs Peter with Pearl and Emma.
At a charity gala, Secretary Ross agrees to register Norman's Spider-Man under the Sokovia Accords and keep it quiet.
Tipped off by Norman, Ross arrests Otto Octavius for breaking the Accords, with Iron Man's help.
